Mira (eng-runtime): FYI ran the long-context synthetic suite (100k tokens, hotset churn) with the new batching + reuse heuristics. Seeing continuous mem growth when KV reuse is enabled — not plateauing after steady state. Reproducer attached: ./bench/kvcache/hotset_repro.py

Jonah: Can you paste the memory curve or flamegraph? Rough numbers help.

Mira (eng-runtime): here are the peak RSS numbers (same host, 8xA100): baseline (reuse off): 28GB -> stable. current (reuse on): 28GB -> 34GB over 2 hours (+21%). Flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/internal/flames/1746001234-hotset.svg

Kevin: Hmm. Any recent kernel-selection changes or allocator tweaks in the window? I recall the kernel pick switcher landed last week.

Mira (eng-runtime): Kernel selector patch is in, but I repro'd on a build pinned before that too. Differences look like fragment reuse bookkeeping not clearing entries in the presence of interleaved evictions.

perf-bot: CI: kvcache-longcontext-bench #987 failed — regression detected (+19% memory). See: https://ci.redwood/internal/987

Sophia: Two quick things: 1) try forcing the legacy eviction policy (KV_EVICT_POLICY=age) to see if it's an eviction policy interplay. 2) Can you run with KV_DEBUG=1 and upload the kv-telemetry log (it prints fragment refcounts + allocations every 5m)?

Mira (eng-runtime): Ran with KV_EVICT_POLICY=age -> memory stabilizes around 29GB (roughly baseline). With KV_DEBUG=1 attached excerpt: 

```
[00:15] fragments=512 active_refs=2048 free_fragments=64 total_alloc=1.2G
[01:15] fragments=519 active_refs=2052 free_fragments=12 total_alloc=1.25G
[02:15] fragments=529 active_refs=2060 free_fragments=3 total_alloc=1.35G
```

Shows free_fragments decreasing to near zero while active_refs slowly tick up. Looks like reuse path hands out new fragments instead of recycling when eviction and compaction race.

Jonah: That log smells like fragmentation + missed reclamation. Could be that we skip compaction when kernel selection picks the fast path. Any conditional around compaction?

Kevin: I looked through the recent runtime commits. There's a short-circuit in the fast-path sticky-kernel where we skip fragment-scan if request latency < threshold. That could bypass reclamation when load is bursty. I can repro locally with a small harness.

Sophia: If that's it, a short-term guard is to run the compaction periodically irrespective of kernel path. Add a timer-based compaction and we'll see if leak stops. Also we should add a regression test to the long-context suite that runs reuse+burst churn for 2h with telemetry assertions.

Mira (eng-runtime): Agreed. Adding a test now. Patch snippet for CI test harness (will go in bench/regtests/kvcache_hotset_regtest.py):

```
# pseudo
def test_hotset_frag_reuse():
    run_benchmark(tokens=100000, reuse=True, churn=0.4, duration=7200)
    assert peak_rss / baseline_rss < 1.15
```

Jonah: Nice. Also add an assert on free_fragments not trending to 0. That'll catch fragmentation+reclaim bugs early.

Mira (eng-runtime): Will add both. For immediate mitigation, Kevin — can you send a small PR that removes the short-circuit for compaction (or gates it behind a per-instance opt-in) so we can revert quickly if needed?

Kevin: Yep, prepping PR now. Will include perf counters and a toggle: --force-compaction. I ran it locally and the mem curve flattens.

perf-bot: PR 1245 created by Kevin: https://git.redwood/pr/1245 — title: "guard-fastpath-compaction-shortcircuit (fix kvcache reuse)"

Mira (eng-runtime): Thanks. I'll attach the CI regression test to the PR and mark the long-run suite as required for kvcache changes. Action items: 1) Kevin PR w/ toggle (in review). 2) Mira adds regtest + telemetry assertions. 3) Sophia to propose schedule for periodic compaction (design doc). 4) Jonah to add flamegraphs to perf dashboard.

Jonah: I'll add the new flamegraph link to the dashboard and annotate the commit range. :eyes:

Sophia: Starting doc now — will ping when draft ready. :memo:

Mira (eng-runtime): TL;DR: found leak when reuse+new fast-path interact; reproduction, CI failure, PR open, regtest added. Will follow up with a short postmortem if PR doesn't clear. :thumbsup:

Kevin: Thanks all. If CI green after PR I'll backport to the release branch. :shipit:
